title: rosa stylosa f. anceps
intro: Rosa stylosa f. anceps, commonly known as the fragrant rose or hip rose, is a plant species belonging to the family Rosaceae. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, including its use in traditional medicine to alleviate symptoms of anxiety and insomnia due to its sedative properties.
